scope: Fresh Gazebo layout_a, identical tunnel staging start, TB steps 9 to 11 only; not an official-start integrated course

driving_trials.configuration: Fixed wall map, duplicate wall-hit exclusion and 5mm supported LiDAR surfaces; soft-obstacle path cost still disabled

replay_finding: Near both failures, a reconstructed grid rejected the planning start against a 20mm dynamic cell. Isolated returns intentionally retain coarse cells; supported surfaces alone use 5mm rectangles.
replay_limitation: Bag replay uses an approximate entry anchor and is not the exact asynchronous live failure snapshot; sensor-noise and pose-error contributions are not quantified.

final_configuration.change: Also restored original obstacle-distance and soft-obstacle path costs, 60mm soft band with value 64 and occupied threshold 65; no additional hard obstacle or stop rule
final_configuration.test_harness_change: Ideal turning test wall-clock allowance raised from 45 to 90 seconds; simulated tick limit and completion assertions unchanged; no runtime timeout change
final_configuration.ros_smoke: PASS: actual TB node with one cmd_vel publisher
final_configuration.gazebo_driving: NOT RUN: two GUI starts and one headless start ended with gzserver exit 139 before clock and sensors
final_configuration.startup_failure_root_cause: Unresolved; observed during graphics initialization, before mission driving. Excluded from driving trial counts.

geometry_method: Recorded world poses and nominal asymmetric body rectangle versus source wall boxes and cylinders; not contact-sensor evidence or continuous collision proof
preservation: Original workspace and clean tunnel-port baseline preserved; trial container stopped and removed
